acceptanceThresholdLimitation: This exploratory pilot locked its varied sample before scoring but did not preregister quantitative pass/fail thresholds. Its findings cannot promote v2.1 to production.
selectionRationale: Ten debates stratified across topic, duration, format, burden posture, participant count, and legacy score shape. Legacy scores are intentionally omitted from this manifest.

debates.motion: Does God exist, and do cosmology, fine-tuning, morality, resurrection, and suffering support or undermine Christian theism?
